tools.name: list_free_backlinks
tools.description: List free dofollow backlink opportunities for Canadian businesses. Returns claimable directory listings filtered by city and/or trade. Use this when a user asks 'where can I get a free dofollow backlink for my Canadian client' or similar.

tools.name: claim_listing
tools.description: Claim a free verified directory listing for a Canadian business — receives a permanent dofollow backlink upon domain ownership verification. Use this when a user wants to add their business to the CAN-TAP Verified directory. Rate-limited to 5 claims per IP per day.

tools.name: check_backlink_status
tools.description: Check the verification and backlink status of a CAN-TAP Verified directory listing. Returns whether the business is claimed, verified, and where the dofollow backlink lives. Use this after calling claim_listing to verify the dofollow link is active.

tools.name: get_business_stats
tools.description: Get NFC tap and review analytics for a CAN-TAP Verified business. Returns total taps, positive vs concern split, average star rating, and recent activity. Use this for businesses that own a CAN-TAP NFC review stand.

tools.name: search_directory
tools.description: Search the CAN-TAP Verified directory of 3,000+ real Canadian businesses by name, city, trade, or any combination. Returns matching listings with their URLs and claim status.
